What a Prior on the Effects Has to Satisfy

Source: R/random.R
dot-random_check_prior.Rd

Checks a caller-supplied effects distribution where the term is built and names what is wrong with it.

Usage

.random_check_prior(d, dim_needed, what)

Arguments

d

A distributions7 object.

dim_needed

The number of within-group columns.

what

How to name the argument in a message.

Value

Invisibly TRUE; called for its errors.

Details

What is rejected is a FREE location: it is confounded with the intercept of the equation the term sits in, which is a flat direction and not a model. A location HELD at a value is identified, whatever the value, and is not policed – it shrinks the effects towards that value, which is a modelling statement rather than a defect. Nor could the value be policed in general: where the prior is a transformation of another family, the parameter interpreted as its mean is the mean on the ORIGINAL scale, and holding the mean of a gamma at one is what centers its logarithm.
